entity: US coal-fired generation change in 2025 vs the rest of the world's coal risers
what_we_add: The 1.8x comparison: US +85 TWh vs 36.26 TWh from the 23 other risers
why: Ember states the identical number, US coal up 85 TWh (+13%) in 2025; Visual Capitalist says the US led the world's coal rise. EIA's 11%/76 BkWh and VC's 93.2 TWh sit within 25%. No source states the 1.8x-all-other-risers-combined comparison.
